# Agent Context Compiler

> Compile large mixed-context inputs into a relevance-ranked, token-budgeted context packet with provenance and omission reasons. Use when an AI coding or research agent needs to select files, notes, logs, or retrieved passages before a task.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/qasimrazamalik-coder/agent-context-compiler
License: MIT
Primary instructions: skill/SKILL.md
Installation: docs/INSTALLATION.md
Safety guardrails: docs/GUARDRAILS.md
Security policy: SECURITY.md
Example input: examples/input.json

## Supported runtimes
Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, MCP-compatible agents, and custom agent runtimes.

## Usage
Run: python skill/scripts/run.py examples/input.json
Test: pytest -q
